newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks slip in London after a firm start.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks slip in London after a firm start.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks gave up initial gains and were trading slightly lower in London in thin trading on Thursday.
A strong showing on Wall Street on Wednesday boosted Hong Kong shares in early in the London trading session, dealers said.
"The Dow came off at the open and we just sort of drifted lower, but there's absolutely no volume behind it," a London dealer said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 29.26 to 12,486.97 at 1433 GMT, having climbed as high as 12,497.81 earlier.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index lost 65.08 points to close at 12,516.23.
